description: This Java class 'DefaultAcknowledgementsAdapterProvider' implements the 'AcknowledgementAdapterProvider' interface and provides adapter instances for handling acknowledgements within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It instantiates and supplies adapters for single acknowledgements and multiple acknowledgements, utilizing header translation and error registry dependencies.

classes.name: DefaultAcknowledgementsAdapterProvider
classes.description: A final class that implements AcknowledgementAdapterProvider to supply adapters related to acknowledgements, instantiated with dependencies such as ErrorRegistry and HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: DefaultAcknowledgementsAdapterProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the acknowledgementAdapter and acknowledgementsAdapter using provided ErrorRegistry and HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: getAdapters
methods.description: Returns a list containing both the acknowledgementAdapter and acknowledgementsAdapter.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for single acknowledgements.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementsAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for multiple acknowledgements.
